name: Chargeback and dispute manager
problem: Disputes are tracked in spreadsheets, so evidence deadlines get missed and fees pile up.
does: Review disputes, attach evidence, accept or contest
sensitive: Accepting a dispute (refunds money) needs ops lead approval

name: AML alert triage
problem: Transaction monitoring alerts land in one inbox with no prioritisation or decision trail.
does: Triage alerts by risk, close as false positive or escalate with a reason
sensitive: Escalating to a SAR filing needs compliance lead approval

name: Sanctions hit review
problem: Screening near-matches are cleared by email, so there is no auditable record of who cleared them.
does: Compare the customer against the watchlist entry and clear or confirm the hit
sensitive: Clearing a hit needs a second reviewer

name: Customer 360 lookup
problem: Support agents juggle five systems to answer one customer question.
does: Search a customer and see profile, payments, KYC status and tickets in one view
sensitive: Viewing SSN or DOB is masked and audited

name: Payout reconciliation
problem: Finance matches bank files to payouts by hand at month end.
does: Match payouts to bank statement lines and flag breaks
sensitive: Writing off a break needs finance lead approval

name: Merchant onboarding review
problem: New merchant applications wait days because the reviewers share a queue.
does: Review merchant applications, request documents, approve or decline
sensitive: Approving high-risk merchants needs risk lead approval

name: Internal access requests
problem: Access to production systems is granted over chat, which leaves no audit trail.
users: Any employee requests; system owners approve
does: Request access to a system with a reason and an expiry
sensitive: Every grant needs the system owner's approval

name: Manual ledger adjustment
problem: Balance corrections are made with direct database edits.
does: Debit or credit an account with a reason
sensitive: Adjustments above $1,000 need ops lead approval
